title: FullCD for coefficients of étale origin
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum with $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p_0$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. Fix a prime $\ell\ne p_0$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, a uniformizer $\varpi_E$ of its valuation ring, and an integer $n\geq1$, and put $A=A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n\mathcal O_E$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $d\in\mathbf N$, let $Y$ and $\overline X$ be finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] with $\dim\overline X\leq d$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension], and let $p:\overline X\to Y$ be a proper finite-type morphism of $k$-schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Work with modules over the constant sheaves of rings with value $A$ on the small étale and pro-étale sites [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let $\mathcal F$ be a sheaf on $\overline X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ equipped with an isomorphism $\mathcal F\cong\nu_{\overline X}^*\mathcal G$ for an étale sheaf $\mathcal G$ of $A$-modules, where $\nu$ is the comparison morphism [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. Then, for every integer $r$, putting sheaves in degree zero and using finite-level derived direct image [def-weil-derived-direct-image] and cohomology sheaves [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves],
$$\mathcal H^r(Rp_*\mathcal F)=0\qquad(r>2d).$$
For every morphism of schemes $v:V\to Y$, form $\overline X_V=\overline X\times_YV$ with projections $g_V:\overline X_V\to\overline X$ and $p_V:\overline X_V\to V$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. With $g_V^*\mathcal F$ the constant-coefficient module pullback [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], one has
$$\mathcal H^r\bigl(R(p_V)_*(g_V^*\mathcal F)\bigr)=0\qquad(r>2d).$$
There is no finite-type or dimension hypothesis on $V$. In particular, this gives both vanishing clauses of [def-weil-full-cohomological-dimension] restricted to original-source sheaves of étale origin, for every object $V\to Y$ of $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$ (and for every étale $Y$-scheme). It does not assert those clauses for arbitrary pro-étale sheaves.

proof.text: The coefficient datum makes $A$ a finite commutative ring. The absolute value on $E$ extends the $\ell$-adic one, so $|\ell|_E=\ell^{-1}<1$ and $\ell\in\mathfrak m_E=\varpi_E\mathcal O_E$. Thus $\ell^n\in\varpi_E^n\mathcal O_E$ and $\ell^nA=0$. Since $\ell\ne p_0$, $\ell^n$ is invertible in $k$: its image is nonzero in this field. Every section of every $A$-module sheaf is consequently killed by $\ell^n$. Properness of $p$ includes separatedness and finite type; finite type includes quasi-compactness, and the separated-to-quasi-separated lemma gives quasi-separatedness. These verify exactly the coefficient and qcqs hypotheses needed below.

source.place: First sentence (torsion coefficients); qcqs hypothesis in the comparison sentence; Stacks 01T1 (definition-finite-type) and schemes.tex, 01KH after 01KK, using 01K7 (lemma-closed-immersion-quasi-compact).

proof.text:
Apply [lem-sf-etale-direct-image-vanishing] to the original finite-type schemes $\overline X,Y$, the finite-type morphism $p$, the finite commutative ring $A$ killed by the invertible integer $\ell^n$, and the arbitrary étale $A$-module sheaf $\mathcal G$. All these hypotheses were given or checked in step 1; the dimension bound is the original $\dim\overline X\leq d$. Therefore $\mathcal H^r(Rp_{\mathrm{et},*}\mathcal G)=0$ for $r>2d$. Put $L=\mathcal G[0]$. It is bounded below. The comparison direct-image isomorphism for qcqs $p$ gives
$$Rp_{\mathrm{proet},*}(
u_{\overline X}^*L)\cong
u_Y^*Rp_{\mathrm{et},*}L.$$
The comparison pullback lemma states exactness on constant-$A$ modules and its cohomology isomorphism, so
$$\mathcal H^r(Rp_*\mathcal F)\cong
u_Y^*\mathcal H^r(Rp_{\mathrm{et},*}L)=0.$$
Here the given isomorphism $\mathcal F\cong
u_{\overline X}^*\mathcal G$ and exactness identify its degree-zero complex with $
u_{\overline X}^*L$. No constructibility assumption has been used.

source.place: First paragraph and absolute vanishing in the second paragraph; exactness spelled out using sites-modules.tex, Tag 04JC (lemma-flat-pullback-exact).

proof.text:
Let $v:V\to Y$ be arbitrary and write $g=g_V$, $p'=p_V$. The comparison-pullback isomorphism identifies
$$g^*\mathcal F\cong\nu_{\overline X_V}^*g_{\mathrm{et}}^{-1}\mathcal G.$$
All coefficients are the same finite constant ring $A$; on pro-étale module sheaves the constant-coefficient inverse image is module pullback and is exact by [prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-exact]. Apply [thm-weil-pbc-finite-level-proetale] to $K=\mathcal F[0]$, the proper morphism $p$, this cartesian square, and the witness $(L,\alpha)$ of [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness], where $L=\mathcal G[0]$ and $\alpha:\nu^*L\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal F[0]$ is the inverse of the given isomorphism in degree zero. Step 2 gives $L\in D^+$. It yields
$$v^*Rp_*\mathcal F\xrightarrow{\sim}R(p')_*g^*\mathcal F.$$
The cited base-change theorem has arbitrary $v$; it imposes no finite-type or dimension hypothesis on $V$. Apply degree-$r$ cohomology. Exactness of $v^*$ and the exact-functor cohomology lemma give
$$\mathcal H^r(R(p')_*g^*\mathcal F)\cong v^*\mathcal H^r(Rp_*\mathcal F)=v^*0=0\qquad(r>2d),$$
by step 2. In particular this argument never applies the finite-type dimension theorem to $\overline X_V$.

source.place: Relative clause, repaired: use proper base change (Stacks 095T, etale-cohomology.tex, theorem-proper-base-change; proetale.tex, 09C8, section-proper-base-change) instead of the unjustified assertion that the base-changed source retains the original dimension. Exactness uses 04JC; passage to cohomology uses homology.tex, 010N (lemma-exact-functor).

proof.text: For the identity base change, step 2 is the first defining vanishing clause of [def-weil-full-cohomological-dimension] for the given $\mathcal F$. For any object $V\to Y$ of $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$, the second clause uses precisely the original-source sheaf pulled back as $g_V^*\mathcal F$; step 3 gives its vanishing with the same bound $2d$. The proof works for each choice of an original-source étale-origin witness, hence for every such $\mathcal F$. It does not replace this restricted quantifier by the definition's quantifier over every pro-étale sheaf.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q19-da066023e (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read every step, every cited statement and the sources; I made no fixes and there are no new nodes. Statement: the source's phrase about base changes 'with source dim<=d, in particular every etale Y-scheme' is wrong: for d=0, X=Spec k -> Y=A^1 and V=Y (identity, etale), dim V=1>d. The corrected statement covers the pullback of the original etale-origin F along every scheme map V->Y. That is stronger than the source on V and keeps the same sheaf quantifier, so nothing is weakened. All three citers stay consistent; thm-sf-fullcd-used-class uses only the absolute clause. Step 1: in E the absolute value of ell is 1/ell<1, so ell lies in (varpi) and ell^n kills A; ell^n is invertible in k; proper means separated and finite type, and lem-pc-separated-quasi-separated gives qcqs. Step 2: every hypothesis of lem-sf-etale-direct-image-vanishing holds on the original finite-type X and Y (k algebraically closed, d in N, any A-module sheaf G). prop-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image needs qcqs p and G[0] in D^+; its pro-etale Ru_* is the functor of def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations, the same one def-weil-derived-direct-image uses. Clauses 2-3 of lem-sf-comparison-pullback-exact give exactness and the cohomology isomorphism. Step 3: thm-weil-pbc-finite-level-proetale needs a finite commutative Lambda, proper f, an arbitrary g in a cartesian square, and K=F[0] with witness (G[0],alpha); alpha points the right way. This matches Stacks 0F0C (etale-cohomology lemma-proper-base-change-mod-n), which I read. prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-exact and lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-complex-cohomology (010N) then give the vanishing of H^r for r>2d. Using proper base change repairs an established error: the source applied the finite-type dimension bound to X x_Y V, and the unit's claim that base change keeps the dimension fails (X=Y=Spec k, V=A^1). The 09C8 completed-coefficient theorem is correctly not used. Step 4 is an elementary substitution into both clauses of def-weil-full-cohomological-dimension, restricted to etale-origin F. Edge cases checked: empty X, d=0, n=1, zero sheaf, non-constructible G, V=Y, P^1 over A^1, V not of finite type. No cycle: about 10.2k nodes in the closure, none of them thm-sf-fullcd-*. No duplicate: thm-sf-fullcd-class and thm-sf-fullcd-used-class are different packagings that cite this item. No SGA source. The upstream Lean candidate (ExceptionalAdjoint.lean:210) is sorry and states a stronger quantifier, so it is not an attachment.
